description: Shared, language-agnostic structural contract for the GET /internal/media/nodes/{node_id}/assignments request headers, consumed by both the Go control-plane client's test suite (internal/controlplane/client_test.go) and the TypeScript Admin structural validator's test suite (eventcast-admin/tests/security/media-agent-node-auth.test.ts). This file contains no real credentials, hostnames, project identifiers, node tokens, or environment values — every value below is a fixed, non-secret, test-only fixture.

scope.proves: Structural request-shape compatibility between the real Go control-plane client (client.go, unmodified production code) and the real TypeScript structural validator (validateMediaAgentAuthStructure, unmodified production code) for the five required EventCast machine-auth headers.
does_not_prove: HMAC-SHA256 credential-digest issuance or verification correctness (computeCredentialDigest / verifyMediaNodeCredential) — Go never computes or verifies this digest; it only ever forwards a raw bearer token it was configured with.
Supabase-backed database behavior (node lookup, credential rows, replay-nonce storage, rate limiting).
Integration with a real, deployed Admin route over a real network or a real staging environment.

examples.name: valid_baseline
examples.description: A fully well-formed header set: valid node id, valid 32-char lowercase-hex request id, matching idempotency key, timestamp exactly at the reference time (in-window).

examples.name: invalid_node_id
examples.description: Node id contains characters outside the accepted charset (space and '!').

examples.name: malformed_request_id
examples.description: Request id is not exactly 32 lowercase-hex characters. Idempotency key is set equal to it so this example isolates the request-id-format failure from any idempotency mismatch.

examples.name: idempotency_key_mismatch
examples.description: Request id and idempotency key are each individually well-formed 32-char lowercase-hex values, but they do not match each other.

examples.name: missing_authorization_header
examples.description: Authorization header is absent (null); every other field matches the valid baseline.

examples.name: timestamp_outside_tolerance_past
examples.description: Timestamp is 600000ms (10 minutes) before the reference time, clearly outside the 300000ms (5 minute) tolerance declared above.

examples.name: timestamp_outside_tolerance_future
examples.description: Timestamp is 600000ms (10 minutes) after the reference time, clearly outside the 300000ms (5 minute) tolerance declared above.
